_source: Prices: decision log, Mike 2026-10-11 20:33, and the product lead's IronStack-only plan map (#154, 2026-11-12 10:58 ET). Spec: briefs/launch/pricing-page-spec.md. IronStack only for GA: MealStack, The Stack and MissionStack are out until March. The page renders only from this file.

plans.name: IronStack Free
plans.what: Unlimited logging, programs and your own exercises, the watch, and a free week of Stack AI.

plans.name: IronStack Pro
plans.what: Stack AI, and your whole training history in Insights.

features.name: Log fast: prefilled sets, RPE, notes, type or say a set
Rest clock, Live Activity, plate math, prep sets for your bar
Apple Watch, with heart rate; it runs the workout when your phone is away
Unlimited programs, workouts and your own exercises
Starter programs, and cue cards for the exercises in the library
Bring your history from Hevy, Strong, JuggernautAI or a spreadsheet
Records, badges and the workout recap
Answers from your phone: your best lift, last time, plate math and swaps
Stack AI: ask anything, swap a lift, write a workout or a program, bring any program
Train with a coach: share what you choose, get their plans

founding.line: Founding price. Keep it as long as you stay.

questions.a: 14 days on IronStack Pro, from Apple. And every new account gets a week of Stack AI.

questions.q: What happens if I stop paying?
questions.a: You keep every set, program and chat. Insights goes back to 30 days.

questions.q: Does the free week need a card?
questions.a: No card. Sign in with Apple once and you get a week of Stack AI, and it ends on its own.
